build_electra_sentence_encoder: build a HuggingFaceElectraSentenceEncoder that loads a pre-trained Electra model from a checkpoint directory
create_electra_config: create a Config object to set the electra checkpoint directory and weight loading options
encode_tokens_with_electra: encode input tokens using the Electra encoder to get hidden states and pooled output
load_electra_weights: load pre-trained Electra model weights from a pytorch_model.bin file into the model
get_electra_word_embeddings: get the word embeddings from the Electra model for weight tying in a MaskedLM
